title.zh: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
title.en: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers

current_state.zh: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI disrupted 112 servers and 241 web domains tied to a multinational crypto investment scam that targeted Russian-speaking Americans and stole tens of millions of dollars, seizing about $300,000 in stolen funds so far.
current_state.en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI disrupted 112 servers and 241 web domains tied to a multinational crypto investment scam that targeted Russian-speaking Americans and stole tens of millions of dollars, seizing about $300,000 in stolen funds so far.
